title: AutoPBO: LLM-powered Optimization for Local Search PBO Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2509.04007v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pseudo-Boolean Optimization (PBO) provides a powerful framework for modeling combinatorial problems through pseudo-Boolean (PB) constraints. Local search solvers have shown excellent performance in PBO solving, and their efficiency is highly dependent on their internal heuristics to guide the search. Still, their design often requires significant expert effort and manual tuning in practice. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in automating algorithm design, their application to optimizing PBO solvers remains unexplored. In this work, we introduce AutoPBO, a novel LLM-powered framework to automatically enhance PBO local search solvers. We conduct experiments on a broad range of four public benchmarks, including one real-world benchmark, a benchmark from PB competition, an integer linear programming optimization benchmark, and a crafted combinatorial benchmark, to evaluate the performance improvement achieved

translated_title: AutoPBO：基于大语言模型的局部搜索伪布尔优化求解器优化方法
translated_abstract: 伪布尔优化通过伪布尔约束为组合问题建模提供了一个强大的框架。局部搜索求解器在伪布尔优化求解中表现出卓越的性能，其效率高度依赖于引导搜索的内部启发式方法。然而，这些启发式方法的设计在实践中往往需要大量的专家投入和手动调优。尽管大语言模型已在自动化算法设计方面展现出潜力，但其在优化伪布尔优化求解器方面的应用仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们提出了AutoPBO，这是一种新颖的基于大语言模型的框架，用于自动增强伪布尔优化局部搜索求解器。我们在四个公开基准测试上进行了广泛的实验，包括一个真实世界基准、一个来自伪布尔竞赛的基准、一个整数线性规划优化基准和一个精心构造的组合基准，以评估所实现的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出AutoPBO，一个利用大语言模型自动增强伪布尔优化局部搜索求解器的新颖框架，并在包括真实世界基准在内的四个公开基准上验证了显著的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AutoPBO, a novel LLM-powered framework that automatically enhances local search PBO solvers, demonstrating significant performance improvements across four public benchmarks including real-world instances.
